scenarios.derivation: AC4 and SME-689: CONFIRMED flows require p.ValueDate IS NOT NULL (CASHFCST.cob:774-802) while the payable linked to the in-flight instruction is excluded from contractual payables (CASHFCST.cob:670-690,738-760); with every other STC instruction settled the confirmed total is 0.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.StatutoryObligation WHERE PeriodKey LIKE 'PE%'

scenarios.derivation: AC1 with named example workflow6Step5, jobs/XMDCLOSE.cmd:20-42 (DAYS always passed, 0 by SETENV.cmd:39, D-XMD-07) and MAXCC = highest step code: OBLIGREG ends 4 on the fresh deploy because open derived obligations are overdue at 20261031 (FR-022), RECONCTL and EXCPAGE end 0 or 4.

scenarios.title: A step ending >= 8 stops the stream and the status follows MAXCC
scenarios.derivation: AC2 with the condition rule of jobs/XMDCLOSE.cmd (if LASTCC GEQ 8 goto ABEND) and contracts 8.4; no repository state lets an XMDCLOSE step end >= 8 through DSL arrangement (it needs a spool or SQL infrastructure failure), so only the converse is pinned: with every step below 8 all three steps run and the stream is not terminated.

scenarios.derivation: AC3 with named example restart and 'if defined P_RESTART goto %P_RESTART%' (jobs/XMDCLOSE.cmd:17); EXCPAGE ends 0 unless the spool or listing fails (EXCPAGE.cob:186-207), so MAXCC is 0 without the OBLIGREG warning.
